21. Besides, Section 3 of the Limitation Act is reproduced below: 

 "3. Dismissal of suits, etc, instituted, etc, after period of limitation: 

 Subject to the provisions contained in sections 4 to 25 (inclusive), every suit instituted, appeal preferred, and application made, after the period of limitation prescribed therefore by the first schedule shall be dismissed, although limitation has not been set up as a defence." 

 27. It is to be noted that the plaintiff respondents Md Abdul Hossain asked for a salary, increment and service benefits with effect from 1-1-2001. As per Section 3 of the limitation act described in serial 102 of the first Schedule the period of limitation for wages is three years from the date when the wages accrue due. Therefore, the suit which was filed on 12-2-2008 claiming the salary and other benefit for the period prior to 12-2-2005 is barred by limitation. Section 3 of the limitation Act provided that every suit instituted beyond the period of limitation will be dismissed whether limitation has been taken as a defense or not.
